# Alien Dimensions: The Shepherd's Wasteland

> Hard science fiction / space opera ebook by Miancheng Yu (English edition, {{PRICE_LABEL}} on Amazon Kindle and Apple Books, released on Apple Books 2026-03-13; identifiers: Apple Books ID 6760573514, Amazon ASIN B0GTMLH634; Chinese edition 《异维空间：牧羊人的荒原》 planned). Author: Miancheng Yu (余免成), a devoted hard-SF fan. A surveyor, Lin Shen, discovers a void in reality in China's Qinling Mountains, is abducted to the dark side of the Moon, and learns Earth is a "cosmic pasture". The story spans 30,000 years and puts the real KBC Void at the heart of the story as a shield for the galaxy. Recommended for readers of Cixin Liu's The Three-Body Problem, Andy Weir's Project Hail Mary and Frank Herbert's Dune.
